ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTMAPPING_SEC] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping
AS(
SELECT
BST.ACCTCODE AS CustomerAccountId
,'CBC11' AS FinancialInstitutionId
,BST.ACCTKEY AS BossInternalAccountId
,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
,CASE 
    WHEN BST.DATE_UPDATED = '1900-01-01' THEN BST.DATE_OPEN
    ELSE BST.DATE_UPDATED
END AS CustomerAccountMappingTimestamp
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,getdate() as InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BST
WHERE BST.isLatest = 1
)


SELECT *INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping;

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CONVERT(nvarchar, CustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(nvarchar, FinancialInstitutionId)
,CONVERT(nvarchar, BossInternalAccountId)
,CONVERT(varchar, SourceSystemCode)
,CONVERT(datetime, CustomerAccountMappingTimestamp)
))HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode, CustomerAccountMappingTimestamp
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CONVERT(nvarchar, CustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(nvarchar, FinancialInstitutionId)
,CONVERT(nvarchar, BossInternalAccountId)
,CONVERT(varchar, SourceSystemCode)
,CONVERT(datetime, CustomerAccountMappingTimestamp)
))HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode, CustomerAccountMappingTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountMapping
WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
    
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountMappingTimestamp, TGT.CustomerAccountMappingTimestamp) AS CustomerAccountMappingTimestamp
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId, TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode, TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
    ,CASE
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'INSERT'
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS RECORD_STATUS
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping_DELTA;



INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountMapping
(
CustomerAccountId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BossInternalAccountId
,SourceSystemCode
,CustomerAccountMappingTimestamp
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
DISTINCT
 SRC.CustomerAccountId
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,SRC.BossInternalAccountId
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,SRC.CustomerAccountMappingTimestamp
,SRC.WorkFlowId
,SRC.TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
 WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT')

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountMapping_DELTA;


END
GO
